A Courtesy Unanswered

You dip your head in a courteous greeting, then bring your hidden blade up beneath your opponent’s guard.

Rules

Action: Main Action · Attribute: Guile

Target / range / shape: One adjacent creature.

Hide your intent in an ordinary gesture, then make a melee attack. If you began Hidden, gain 1 Boon to this attack and end Hidden normally.

- Weak: 3 physical damage. - Standard: 3 physical damage and Slowed 1. - Strong: 5 physical damage and Slowed 2.

Duration: Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.

Equipment / acquisition: Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.

---

Tier / minimum level: 1 · DP: 2 · Requirements to learn: Subterfuge 1

Type: Skill / Attack

Limits: Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
